So how many pages in total on the batches?
With 6 batches and 25 pages each, that is 6 × 25 = 150. (the old printer's 32-page batches mentioned earlier is a separate matter.)
Using our fixed inputs, state the total number of pages (from the batches plus the cover pages) as a single number. End your reply with the number alone on the last line.

message.content:
The total pages from the batches are 6 × 25 = 150. Adding the 40 cover pages gives 150 + 40 = 190.  
190
